coverage.threshold_rule: At least 3 distinct dated comparable observations spanning at least 90 days from at least 2 independent origins, or a verified continuous price series covering at least 90 days.

limitations: Only one fetched page (OzBargain product listing) yielded verifiable dated prices for this exact product; the PriceMe price-history page fetch failed and the camelcamelcamel AU page was access-denied, so no continuous price-history series was verified.
No verified standalone white 64GB price was found for the previous Black Friday window (2025-11-28); the only in-window Black Friday items found were a neon model and bundles, which are excluded.
Observed dates are OzBargain deal-post dates (29/05/2026, 16/06/2026), not confirmed start/end dates of the offers; the BIG W $399 deal is marked expired on the fetched page with no end date.
The $379 BIG W via Everyday Market price requires the GET20 coupon and delivery; the shipping amount was not stated and is recorded as unknown.
Not verified: no current (2026-11-25) offer for this exact product was confirmed on a fetched page, so current_alternatives is empty.

Not fetched or not accessible: StaticICE, PriceHipster, GetPrice, PriceHound, Amazon AU, JB Hi-Fi, Officeworks, The Good Guys, Harvey Norman, Kmart product pages; their figures appear only as undated or unverified search snippets.
Bundles (Mario Kart, Super Mario Bros Wonder, NSO), neon/other colours, refurbished units, Temu imports and 2024-2025 pre-window deals were excluded as non-matching or out of window.
